axis.def: One of the two number lines of a graph: the horizontal axis (x-axis) runs left to right and the vertical axis (y-axis) runs up. On a market graph quantity goes across and price goes up.

ordered-pair.def: Two numbers in parentheses, (x, y), that locate one point: the horizontal value first, then the vertical value.

direct-relationship.def: A direct (positive) relationship means two variables rise and fall together; an inverse (negative) relationship means one rises as the other falls.
